properties.name: Rocket equation rung on 0.90.0 (design 1859065c2b348074): PASS. The ideal rocket equation reads shown as a conditional on six named assumptions. Dropping "no gravity" takes every Saturn V number and leaves the theorem and the gravity-loss form standing. NASA Glenn's printed V_eq formula was caught as dimensionally wrong, and the Saturn V total is carried as a range (8.5–14.5 km/s). But reflow2 checks no units itself (the calculator did), and propagate_from's reply cannot be bounded.
